en.title: Collect Sticks
en.description:
The bird starts from an empty position, first goes right to take the nearest non-empty stick and returns to the start, then alternates left and right until the total length of the sticks taken is at least 100. It is guaranteed that there is always a stick in the required direction. Output the 0-based indices taken.

The semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and the limits marked as "this site's addition" were compiled by this site and do not mean the original problem provided them.
en.input: n≤2000, n lengths (0..10⁹, where 0 means empty), and the 0-based empty position bird; the start is empty, and until the cumulative length reaches at least 100, there is always a stick to take in the current direction. The upper bound on n and the length range are this site's additions. The internal cumulative length may exceed 32 bits.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness and complexity.
